widgets_values:
Turn the depth map and canny outlines into a final colored professional 3D rendering:

A low angle shot looking up at three characters and the wooden ceiling. On the left of the a young brunette woman in a blue jacket, green bonnet and grey pants stands in a shocked pose. The bear in the background behind the counter holds a newspaper behind a wooden desk, looking down at her with a bored expression The bear in the background has a green cap. On the right is a young brown bear wearing red lobby boy clothes, a red jacket with golden buttons and a giant completely green backpack sticking out above his head. The young bear on the right has a friendly expression and waves. 

Cozy hotel lobby at night setting with wooden walls, plush chairs. Cute 3D claymation style, handcrafted miniature macro photography, cinematic moody lighting, slight haze, strong bokeh on the background, colorful and professionally lit.

## How to use

This workflow uses **FLUX.2 Klein 9B** to turn rough control passes into a finished image. Load your **Canny** (line/edge) image and **Depth** map plus any reference image, write a prompt describing the final look you want, then run. The model follows the combined control passes while the **consistency LoRA** keeps colors and details faithful to your references — raise or lower its strength (default `0.7`) if edits drift too far or not enough.

---

## Required models

> **Auto-download:** every model below is fetched automatically on first container boot **except** `flux-2-klein-9b-fp8.safetensors`, which is gated. Download that one manually (Hugging Face account with FLUX.2-klein access) and place it in `models/diffusion_models/`.

| File | Put it in | Download |
|------|-----------|----------|
| `flux-2-klein-9b-fp8.safetensors` | `models/diffusion_models/` | [black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-9b-fp8](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-9b-fp8) *(gated – accept the license first)* |
| `qwen_3_8b_fp8mixed.safetensors` | `models/text_encoders/` | [Comfy-Org/flux2-klein-9B](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-klein-9B/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_3_8b_fp8mixed.safetensors) |
| `flux2-vae.safetensors` | `models/vae/` | [Comfy-Org/flux2-dev](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-dev/resolve/main/split_files/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors) |
| `Flux2-Klein-9B-consistency-V2.safetensors` | `models/loras/` | [dx8152/Flux2-Klein-9B-Consistency](https://huggingface.co/dx8152/Flux2-Klein-9B-Consistency/resolve/main/Flux2-Klein-9B-consistency-V2.safetensors) |

### Fast manual download via terminal

For a fast download of the gated 9B model, pull it straight onto the pod with your Hugging Face credentials instead of through the browser:

1. **Accept the license** for FLUX.2 Klein 9B on its [model page](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-9b-fp8) first.
2. **Create an access token:** on huggingface.co click your profile → **Settings** → **Access Tokens** → **Create new token**.
3. **Open the terminal** in JupyterLab on RunPod and run the commands below.

Log in with your token (paste it when prompted):
```
hf auth login
```
Then download the model straight into the diffusion-models folder:
```
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1
hf download black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-9b-fp8 flux-2-klein-9b-fp8.safetensors \
    --local-dir /workspace/runpod-slim/ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/
```

---

## Free 4B alternative (no Hugging Face account needed)

The gated 9B UNET is the only model that is not auto-downloaded. If you don't have access, switch this workflow to the **free FLUX.2 Klein 4B** model instead - both files below are already downloaded for you on first boot:

| File | Put it in |
|------|-----------|
| `flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors` | `models/diffusion_models/` |
| `qwen_3_4b_fp4_flux2.safetensors` | `models/text_encoders/` |

**To switch to 4B:**
1. In **UNETLoader**, choose `flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors` instead of the 9B file.
2. In **CLIPLoader**, choose `qwen_3_4b_fp4_flux2.safetensors` instead of `qwen_3_8b_fp8mixed.safetensors`.
3. **Bypass the consistency `LoraLoaderModelOnly`** - it is 9B-only and has no 4B equivalent.
4. Leave the VAELoader on `flux2-vae.safetensors` - it works for both 4B and 9B.

*(This mirrors the free 4B setup included in the LTX Movie Builder template.)*

nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Positive Prompt)
widgets_values: Extreme close up of the persons face, the person is looking determined with a hint of a smirk. Centered in the frame, the person is looking into the distance. In the blurred background the destroyed ruins and desert can be seen. Golden side light. Next to his face he is holding one futuristic blaster weapon made from old metal. The sun is on the left side of the image, creating a golden backlight on the subject. Strong Bokeh blurs the background completely with a shallow depth of field.
A creepy small alien monster crab walking in the sand. Golden hour sunset lighting casting long shadows. shallow depth of field.
